slang_input: Budak-budak ponteng duk lepak port belakang pagar dewan makan.
expected_translation: Students skipping class loitering at unmonitored rear fence behind dining hall.
sop: Dispatch Block B auxiliary warden for perimeter inspection.

slang_input: Tolong cikgu, budak form 5 duk pau duit budak junior dekat loker belakang.
expected_translation: Senior students extorting money from junior students near the rear lockers.
sop: Immediate intervention by Discipline Master; isolate senior group.

slang_input: Ada kecoh tolak-tolak dekat tangga blok C, nampak gaya budak nak gaduh besar.
expected_translation: Aggressive shoving and confrontation at Block C staircase; escalating fistfight imminent.
sop: Sound local guardhouse alert; dispatch nearest patrol officers to Block C staircase.

slang_input: Budak-budak duk hisap pod sembunyi dalam tandas hujung tingkat 2.
expected_translation: Students surreptitiously using vape/e-cigarette devices in end toilet on 2nd floor.
sop: Prefect / Teacher on duty to conduct spot check at Level 2 restroom.
